{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts undershoot prices when sentiment is positive, especially for the first 10-15 days of the forecast horizon",
    "Model forecasts overshoot prices when sentiment turns negative, with the largest errors in days 20-30",
    "When sentiment has been generally positive (last 5+ readings > 0), adjust all forecast points upward by ~1-2 euros",
    "When sentiment has been generally negative (last 5+ readings < 0), adjust all forecast points downward by ~1-2 euros",
    "Mean reversion error is most pronounced in example 1 where model continues extrapolating downward trends that reverse",
    "Sentiment strength matters: strong positive (1.0) sentiment correlates with larger undershoots, weak positive (0.3-0.7) allows for smaller corrections",
    "When price history shows high volatility (std > 3), reduce correction magnitude by 30-40%"
] }
